threads.body: This snapshot marks two malformed known part types as valid. `TextPart.content` and `BlobPart.modality`/`content` are required, but the broad `GenericPart` union branch accepts both objects, so `errors: []` locks that fallback in as intended behavior and would make CI reject a future schema fix. Restrict `GenericPart` to unknown `type` values, regenerate the schema, and snapshot the resulting required-property errors here.
threads.hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+# yaml-language-server: $schema=../case.schema.json
+description: A text part without `content`, and a blob part without `modality` or `content`
+schema: gen-ai-input-messages.json
+document: [
+  {
+    "role": "user",
+    "parts": [
+      { "type": "text" },
+      { "type": "blob", "mime_type": "image/png" }
+    ]
+  }
+]
+# Regenerate with `uv run pytest --update-snapshots`, do not edit by hand.
+errors: []

replies.body: `input-messages-parts-missing-required.yaml` was added in the base PR (#583) to snapshot `main`'s existing behavior where `GenericPart` (`type: str`) accepts malformed `text` and `blob` parts. The `GenericPart` fix (`type: "generic"`) and the updated `required` error snapshots are in the next PR in the stack (#584).
